# Tidepool Landing Page: Build Plan

**Visual direction:** Deep tidal teal (#0E3B43) and sand (#F4EFE6) as the base, with seafoam (#7FD1C0) for interactive states and a single warm amber (#E9A23B) reserved for primary CTAs. Headings in a high-contrast serif (Fraunces or similar); body in a clean grotesk (Inter or similar). A recurring wave-line motif separates sections and doubles as the week's rhythm: seven segments, one per day.

**1. Nav:** Logo left, three links (Product, Teams, Pricing), a "Start free" button right. Sticky, sand background, thins on scroll.

**2. Hero:** Two columns. Left: headline, one-line subhead, amber CTA, and "No card required" beneath. Right: a product screenshot of a shared week board, slightly tilted, with a seafoam cursor showing a teammate's edit. Headline copy: "Plan the week together, before it starts." Subhead names the team and the outcome: "Tidepool gives small teams one shared week: who owns what, what's due when, and what changed since Monday."

**3. Proof strip:** Single row of three numbers ("12 min average weekly planning," etc.) on teal. Real figures only; no placeholders.

**4. Problem:** Centered, short. Copy addresses scattered plans across chats, docs, and memory. Visual: a split image showing a cluttered message thread fading into a clean week view.

**5. How it works:** Three horizontal steps along the wave-line, one per node. Set the week (Monday), assign the work (Tuesday), review together (Friday). Each step gets a small static screen crop.

**6. Feature grid:** Four cards, 2×2, sand-on-white. Shared calendar, owner tags, handoff notes, weekly recap. Icons are simple line drawings in teal.

**7. Pull quote:** Full-width teal band, large serif quote from a real customer with name, role, and team size. Attribution is mandatory.

**8. Teams and pricing:** Three tiers in cards. Middle tier highlighted with amber border. Copy stresses team size and included seats, not feature lists.

**9. FAQ:** Accordion, five to six questions: setup time, integrations, data export, team limits, who sees what.

**10. Final CTA and footer:** Full-bleed teal, one-sentence invitation, amber button. Footer in sand with links, privacy, and a small wave-line signature.
final:
# Tidepool Landing Page: Revised Build Plan

**Visual direction:** Deep tidal teal (#0E3B43) and sand (#F4EFE6) as the base. Seafoam (#7FD1C0) marks live activity, such as teammate cursors and "just changed" highlights. Amber (#E9A23B) appears only on primary CTAs, with dark teal text for contrast. Headings use a high-contrast serif (Fraunces or similar). Body copy uses a clean grotesk (Inter or similar). A thin tide-line, a wavy hairline with small "last updated" timestamps, separates sections and shows that the page is about a shared, changing plan.

**1. Nav:** Logo left, three links (Product, Teams, Pricing), a secondary "Log in" link, and a primary "Start free" button. Sticky, sand background, with a hairline border that appears on scroll.

**2. Hero:** Two columns. Left: headline, a one-line subhead, the amber CTA, and "Free for teams of up to five. No card required." Right: a product screenshot of a shared week board, with a seafoam cursor labeled "Priya, 2 min ago" on one task. Headline: "Your team's week, planned together." Subhead: "Tidepool puts owners, deadlines, and changes in one shared week, so Monday's plan still holds on Friday."

**3. Proof strip:** Three figures on a sand band, each with a one-line source note ("from 300 beta teams, 2024"). Use only verified numbers. If none exist yet, replace the strip with three specific commitments (setup in under five minutes, export anytime, no ads).

**4. Problem:** Centered, under 80 words. Names the real friction: plans split across chats, docs, and memory, so the same question gets asked twice. Visual: a simple, unstyled message thread on the left that resolves into a clean week view on the right, with no decorative effects.

**5. How it works:** Three steps in a horizontal row, connected by the tide-line. Each step pairs a short verb ("Set the week," "Assign the work," "Review together") with a static screen crop showing that exact action. Copy names the time involved for each step.

**6. Feature grid:** Four cards in a 2×2 layout. Shared week, owner tags, handoff notes, and Friday recap. Each card leads with the problem it solves, not the feature name. Icons are single-weight teal line drawings.

**7. Pull quote:** Full-width teal band with a large serif quote. Attribution includes name, role, team size, and a link to the customer's team page where available. Used only with written permission.

**8. Pricing:** Three tiers, ordered by team size ("up to 5," "up to 15," "16+"). The middle tier carries the amber outline and the label "Most teams start here." Each card lists included seats first, then a single line on what's added.

**9. FAQ:** Accordion with six questions: setup time, who sees what, data export, integrations, team limits, and what happens to the plan when someone leaves.

**10. Final CTA and footer:** Full-bleed teal. One sentence: "Plan next week before this one ends." Amber button. Sand footer with product, company, and privacy links, plus the tide-line signature.

**Responsive:** On mobile, the hero screenshot stacks below the headline, and the how-it-works steps become a vertical sequence.
